summary: Animation/flight state of a jump in progress (both sides). Initialised by eoc::jump::helpers::SetupJumpInitialState (bg3.exe+0x114B1F0), advanced by eoc::jump::helpers::UpdateJumpState and by the jump TrajectoryAnimationStateSystems (client UpdateJumpAnimationState bg3.exe+0x1A21CA0). Born live in the jump situation, a mud-mephit fight and a tadpoling pod, with jump::AnimationRequestOneFrameComponent.

fields.name: Direction
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x114B0B0 (called by SetupJumpInitialState/UpdateJumpAnimationState with the state as 2nd arg) stores a normalised direction between two points of the path mover at +0..+0xB when its pitch is <= 1.553 rad. Live unit-length vectors e.g. (0.155, 0.862, -0.475).

fields.name: State
fields.evidence: SetupJumpInitialState writes -1; UpdateJumpAnimationState sets 0/1 (takeoff), 2, 3/4 (landing), 5 (finished/aborted) and compares with < 3; the new value is sent in jump::AnimationRequestOneFrameComponent. Live -1.

fields.name: Time
fields.evidence: SetupJumpInitialState writes 0; UpdateJumpAnimationState adds GameTime delta (+8) each frame. Live 0.

fields.name: PeakTime
fields.evidence: SetupJumpInitialState sets +0x14 and +0x1C from the same value; when Time crosses it State becomes 1 (takeoff time). Live 0.109 .. 0.32. | Name: Toolkit eoc::jump::helpers::SetupJumpInitialState (EoCShared.dll+0x133EAE0, same offsets as bg3.exe: Time +0x10, State +0xC) stores PathMover::SampleDuration(PathMover::GetInterpolationAtHeightPoint()) here: the time of the jump's highest point.

fields.name: FallStartTime
fields.evidence: SetupJumpInitialState writes +0x1C (or half of it); used as the next phase threshold in UpdateJumpAnimationState. Live equals +0x1C. | Name: SetupJumpInitialState: when the drop is at least the stats ExtraData FallDamageMinimumDistance, the time where the path crosses the start height again (GetInterpolationAtSourceYIntersection) or min(Duration/2, 0.3); otherwise Duration.

fields.name: Duration
fields.evidence: Written by SetupJumpInitialState; read when State becomes 2. Live 0.25 .. 0.91. | Name: SetupJumpInitialState stores PathMover::SampleDuration(1.0): the duration of the whole jump path.

fields.name: Started
fields.evidence: SetupJumpInitialState clears it; UpdateJumpAnimationState sets it to 1 when the flight starts (projectile taken off hold) and returns early while it is 0.

fields.name: field_21
fields.evidence: Set to (request byte == 0) from a land request map in UpdateJumpAnimationState; leads to State 3/4/5.

fields.name: field_22
fields.evidence: Copied from the same land request byte; leads to State 3 or 5.

fields.name: IsLongFall
fields.evidence: Set by SetupJumpInitialState; selects State 4 instead of 3 and enables the State 2 phase. | Name: SetupJumpInitialState sets it to (start height - end height >= ExtraData FallDamageMinimumDistance); selects the falling phase (State 2) and landing State 4.

fields.name: field_24
fields.evidence: Set from land request bytes 1/2; selects State 5 instead of 3. Live 0.

fields.name: FinishRequested
fields.evidence: Server UpdateJumpAnimationState (Toolkit) sets it when a jump finish request arrives. Live 0. | Name: Server UpdateJumpAnimationState (Toolkit) sets it when a jump finish request arrives.

open_questions: Names of the three phase-time floats and the land-request flags; offsets confirmed on Windows (bg3.exe) only for the client update and SetupJumpInitialState.
field_21 / field_22 / field_24 come from bytes of the land request map in UpdateJumpAnimationState; the request struct's members (eoc::jump land request) would name them.
